start: A gym member with workouts in the last 4 weeks, on Settings, Your data

steps.action: Tap 'Ask an AI about your workouts'
user_sees: Page 'Ask an AI' with 'Get advice on your training from an AI app you already use, like ChatGPT or Gemini...'
'MettleUp sends nothing. You choose where the text goes. Your name, phone number and body weight are left out.'
Button 'Share to an AI app' and 'The text you will share' with the text in a card
must_not: The member's name, phone number or body weight in the text
Workouts older than 4 weeks in the text

user_sees: One line per exercise: '<exercise>: <n> workouts. Best set ... (<date>)' and a question at the end
must_not: A figure that body weight can be worked out from

steps.action: Tap 'Share to an AI app', pick ChatGPT
user_sees: The phone's share menu, then ChatGPT with the text pasted
must_not: MettleUp sending the text anywhere itself
Two share menus from a double tap

start: A gym member on 'Ask an AI'

steps.action: Long-press the text and copy part of it
user_sees: The text can be selected and copied

steps.action: Paste it into an AI app by hand
must_not: Hidden extra data in the copied text

start: A gym member with no workouts in the last 4 weeks, or the workouts cannot be read

user_sees: 'No workouts in the last 4 weeks' - 'Log a workout, then come back here to ask an AI about it.'
must_not: A share button that shares nothing

steps.action: Open it when the workouts cannot be read
user_sees: 'Couldn't read your workouts' - 'Please go back and open this page again.'
must_not: 'No workouts in the last 4 weeks' for a failed read

steps.action: Share when the share menu cannot open

start: A gym member who opened 'Ask an AI' with no recent workouts

steps.action: Leave, log a workout, come back
user_sees: The share button and the text with the new workout
must_not: The old empty message until the app restarts

steps.action: Change Units from kg to lb, come back

must_not: The deleted workout still in the text

start: A gym member sharing the text to any app

steps.action: Pick a chat app instead of an AI app
user_sees: The text goes only where the member picks
must_not: The text sent to the gym, trainers or MettleUp

steps.action: Check the text for private data
must_not: Name, phone number, body weight, photos or notes in the text
